responsibility: Implements the generic character I/O dispatch layer used by higher runtime libraries, maintaining stacks of current input and output procedures so modules can temporarily redirect Read and Write behavior. By default it routes to IO_Read and IO_Write, but its push/pop mechanism is what enables components such as PushBackInput diagnostics to redirect output without changing all callers.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file is the operative dispatch engine behind GStdIO.h: it allocates the read/write callback stacks, initializes them to IO_Read and IO_Write, and enforces push/pop behavior at runtime. The header only declares the callback record types and exported operations.
